projects.title: Website Penjualan Rumah (HouseING Property)
projects.description: Mengembangkan platform pencarian dan simulasi properti modern berbasis Angular Standalone Components dan TypeScript strict. Memanfaatkan keunggulan Angular Signals (signal, computed, effect) untuk manajemen reaktivitas state berkecepatan tinggi tanpa overhead Zone.js berlebih, sinkronisasi kalkulator simulasi KPR formula anuitas perbankan secara real-time, penjelajahan denah arsitektur 2D interaktif (multi-floor switcher dan visual orientasi kompas) pada 60 FPS, serta pengurutan data properti instan.

projects.title: Website Prediksi Siklon Tropis (LSTM Forecasting)
projects.description: Aplikasi web prediksi lintasan siklon tropis berbasis riset skripsi dengan model Deep Learning LSTM. Mengevaluasi 12 skenario eksperimen terkontrol pada 2 Data Perairan Samudra Hindia dengan 4 variasi timesteps, membuktikan window 8-16 menghasilkan akurasi terbaik dengan rata-rata error Haversine 14,2 km dan R² 0,999. Model LSTM dikonversi ke ONNX Runtime untuk inferensi serverless langsung di browser, dipadukan dengan frontend Astro Island Architecture untuk performa Zero-JS default di Edge CDN dan visualisasi peta interaktif untuk mitigasi risiko bencana di pesisir Sumatera Barat.

Utilized Angular Signals (signal, computed, effect) to model fine-grained reactive state, enabling real-time annuity-based mortgage calculation, multi-attribute facet filtering, and interactive 2D architectural blueprint rendering with floor switching.

projects.title: Tropical Cyclone LSTM Forecasting Platform
projects.description: Engineered an interactive web platform based on undergraduate thesis research utilizing Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) recurrent neural networks to forecast tropical cyclone tracks. Conducted 12 controlled experimental scenarios across 3 oceanic basins with varying temporal sequence lengths, demonstrating that an 8–16 timestep sliding window yielded optimal spatial precision (mean Haversine distance error: 14.2 km; R²: 0.999). Quantized the model to ONNX format to support zero-backend in-browser inference, delivered via Astro Islands architecture on edge CDN infrastructure for real-time disaster risk mitigation analysis.
